original_cells: C++ support in mXparser – key assumptions
No new native ownership model; umbrella header and static initialization
mXparser – Math Expression Evaluator / Parser – Library Description
Console behavior tested separately in browsers/Node
Boolean expressions still evaluate to native numeric values
All built-in operator/function strings evaluated in WASM
Preserve shared native arguments and dependent arguments
Callback extension contract is separate case
Preserve signed width semantics of C++ library
Bindings needed for abstract callback interface
PrimesCache overload requires native API review
No grammar changes, check Unicode conversion
Records exposed as ergonomic JS collections, without changing register
Do not implement rounding in JS
Cover all 21 settings including return types and overloads
Typed-array bridging; preserve opt-in security and native formats
Native clone graph; no JS clone logic
Exporting help in the TXT format
Exporting help in the CSV format
Exporting help in the HTML table format
Exporting help in the Markdown table format
Exporting help in the JSON format
Do not change method return to parsed object; optional helper separate
Exact language argument must be checked in C++ tutorial/source
Minimal bridge for JS to provide full/partial resources
Never auto-confirm on behalf of consumer
